event: DeepMind published its CASP14 account of AlphaFold protein-structure prediction.
The AlphaFold paper addresses predicting three-dimensional protein structures from amino-acid sequences.
DeepMind’s AlphaFold paper reports training on TPU v3 infrastructure.
John Jumper is credited as a co-author of the 2021 AlphaFold paper.
The AlphaFold paper lists John Jumper with a DeepMind affiliation.
The April 2023 combination announcement identifies Demis Hassabis as DeepMind CEO.
Google DeepMind identified John Jumper as a Director in its October 2024 announcement.

Sundar Pichai announced on 5 August 2026 that Demis Hassabis would become Chair of Google DeepMind; Hassabis stated that he was handing over his day-to-day operational responsibilities at GDM so that he would have time and space to focus on the big picture.
Sundar Pichai announced on 5 August 2026 that Demis Hassabis would become Chief Scientist of Alphabet.
